basic_info.description: Newly updated and fresh price! Picture-postcard panoramic views punctuate this 10th floor condo in one of Russian Hill's most coveted luxury boutique buildings on the iconic Little Paris block.  Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the unobstructed classic views that unfold to the quintessential San Francisco experience. The aperture expands to the full-span Golden Gate Bridge, Marin, Alcatraz, Angel Island, the North Bay, Coit Tower, and the high-rise cityscape of downtown. This top-of -the world bridge-to-bridge 2BD/2BA condominium in its original pristine condition with newer upgraded windows is poised for your personal touch. Perfect pied-a-terre or luxe residence. Green Hill Tower epitomizes true luxury with privacy, on-site manager, full-service doorman 24/7, semi-private lobbies on each floor, secure and immaculate pkg garage with interior access, fitness room, and discreet main lobby. One car pkg and large storage locker included. Quintessential Russian Hill living. Seller participating in 1031 Exchange at no cost to buyer. UNIT VIRTUALLY STAGED/IMAGES DIGITALLY ENHANCED.
